remarks: Welcome to easy, carefree living in the heart of Saugatuck. This bright and efficiently designed 550 sq ft studio offers everything you need in one smart, comfortable space. The full kitchen is equipped with a range, refrigerator, dishwasher, and microwave, with durable tile flooring. The main living area features wall-to-wall carpeting, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere perfect for relaxing or working from home.  Even better - your rent includes heat, and hot water, helping to keep monthly expenses simple and predictable. A built-in AC wall unit is provided. Tenant is only responsible for electricity, cable and internet. Enjoy the convenience of shared laundry within the complex, and step outside to experience all that Saugatuck has to offer. You're just a short walk to the train, local restaurants, and coffee shops, with Longshore Club Park and Compo Beach just minutes away. The complex entrance is located at 490 Riverside Ave., and the unit includes one assigned off-street parking space.
